LC 47 3558S The House Committee on Rules offers Bill 397 (RULES COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Fleming of the following substitute to HB 397: 114th, LaHood of the 175th, Leverett of the 123rd, Gullett of the 19th, Scoggins of the 14th, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 2 of Title 21 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to elections and primaries generally, so as to revise procedures for the removal of members of … General Assembly is in session by a majority vote of the house which elected him or her, or at any time when the General Assembly is not in session by the President of the Senate if such member was
LC 47 3558S elected by the Senate or by the Speaker of the House of Representatives if such member was elected by the House of Representatives. In the event a vacancy should occur in the office of such a member of the board … house whose presiding officer appointed him or her in the same manner as a member elected by a house of the General Assembly."
SECTION 2. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
